name: my-ba-flow
description: Business Analyst pipeline aligned to the internal BA Handbook v2.1 (https://ba.learning.my.id). Two work models: project based (a client need, from project kickoff to solution evaluation across the 8-phase BA lifecycle) and product based (a finished app handed over as zip or rar: product onboarding, guided demo or FGD for prospective clients, fit-gap, then entry into a Handbook project).
